title: Preserve metadata text in AlphaTab and verify legacy metadata losses
scope: Fix GP8 metadata text serialization that silently corrupts line breaks in the pinned consumer, and complete independent coverage for supported credits/notices while retaining explicit legacy-only metadata omissions.
acceptance: A valid score with Notice=["First notice","Second notice"] must export under strict preservation with no loss report and raw pinned AlphaTab notices equal "First notice\nSecond notice". The current output yields a NUL separator and is a failing regression.

Preserve supported metadata text with embedded line breaks, tabs, XML metacharacters and Unicode. Independently cover boundary whitespace without a CDATA terminator and a literal CDATA terminator without boundary whitespace; retaining encodings are verified for both classes. Assert raw consumer Music, Tabber, Instructions and Notices independently; Author and Transcriber must not alias Writer or each other.

For boundary whitespace combined with the literal CDATA terminator, require a verified retaining encoding or a precise consumer-loss report and strict refusal with zero bytes. Test the exact string LF + TAB + A<&]]>B + TAB + LF. Preserve the full XML/Go text; do not accept the suffix-only result from split CDATA. An unrelated allowance must not bypass the new loss. Record the exact remaining consumer normalization when explicitly allowed.

" exactly in the raw consumer; Go import may split the embedded line and must retain the existing gp8.normalize.notice-lines report. Separately test one empty notice with gp8.omit.empty-notice and ordinary leading/trailing empty entries that are representable as separators.

Retain exact gp8.omit.writer/comments/date/clipboard-range reports for independent nondefault values. Strict export rejects unallowed losses and selective allowlisting cannot hide a remaining metadata loss.
Fix encoding without repurposing credits or adding undocumented target fields; keep capability export partial because binary-only fields and notice slice-boundary limits remain.
exclusions: No attempt to preserve distinct legacy Writer/Comments/Date/clipboard values in unrelated GPIF fields.
No oracle upgrade or broad normalization of NUL/whitespace differences.

Wanted LF + TAB + A<&]]>B + TAB + LF. Standard split CDATA returns only >B + TAB + LF. Decimal-escaped regular text returns A<&]]>B with boundary whitespace removed. Controls retain a literal terminator without boundary whitespace, and a single CDATA retains boundary whitespace/tabs/metacharacters without the terminator. Fix independently proven metadata text cases and add raw consumer regressions. One CDATA retains boundary whitespace; ordinary escaped text retains a literal CDATA terminator without boundary whitespace. Their combination needs an independently verified encoding or a precise strict consumer-loss policy: pinned AlphaTab retains only the final CDATA section and trims ordinary text boundaries. Retain existing legacy-only omissions and notice slice-boundary reports.
